title: Move from Ask to Plan to Code
steps: Choose enforced Ask. Explore read-only; the offered tools must be filtered and effectful writes denied at dispatch.
Create a Plan task with a named artifact scope. The plan file and review comments are the artifact.
Review the frozen plan and comments. Approval does not broaden tool policy.
Start a new Code task with an explicit contract, permissions, model and finish level.
The Code admission binds the approved plan version and execution envelope.
forbidden_fake_states: approving a plan and silently broadening authority
treating a preset label as a permission grant
complete_when: a new Code admission binds the approved plan version and execution envelope (p.183).
traceability: p.183; controls A-01..A-12; acceptance A09, A10.
